definition: to clear of blame; to justify
example: The new evidence vindicated the defendant.

definition: a person highly skilled in an art
example: The virtuoso stunned the audience with one encore after another.

definition: ostentatiously rich and luxurious or lavish
example: The opulent palace drew visitors from across the continent.

definition: sounding sad and mournful
example: Her plaintive song lingered in the empty hall.

definition: spending money or resources freely and recklessly
example: His prodigal spending alarmed the board.

definition: not what it appears to be; false or fake
example: The expert dismissed the painting as spurious.

definition: diverse in character or content; composed of mixed parts
example: The population was remarkably heterogeneous.

definition: not conducive to success; unpromising
example: It was an inauspicious start to the campaign.

definition: showing a lack of respect for things usually treated with respect
example: His irreverent jokes shocked the congregation.

definition: to praise highly, especially in a public context
example: Critics lauded the debut film.

definition: a region of partial or complete shadow
example: A small umbra crossed the sun during the partial eclipse.

definition: displaying or having a disinclination for physical exertion
example: The languid afternoon invited a nap.

definition: skillful use of one hands in performing tricks; deception
example: The verdict was achieved by legal legerdemain.

definition: to irritate or provoke
example: Her silence nettled him more than any reply would have.

definition: extremely poor; poverty-stricken
example: Her penurious upbringing taught her the value of money.

definition: to lower in rank, prestige, or esteem
example: He refused to abase himself before the committee.

definition: to renounce or relinquish a throne or authority
example: The king abdicated in favor of his son.

definition: to choose not to do or take part in some thing
example: She abstained from voting on the motion.

definition: characterized by self-discipline and moderation
example: His abstemious diet kept him lean.

definition: a deep or seemingly bottomless chasm
example: The climber peered into the abyss below.

definition: growth or increase by gradual addition
example: The reef grew by accretion over centuries.

definition: sharp or sour in taste or manner
example: Her acidulous wit alienated some colleagues.

definition: the highest point or stage of development
example: The empire was at the acme of its power.

definition: to make impure by adding inferior substances
example: The committee noted the adulterate of the situation.

definition: to recommend or support by argument
example: She advocated for stricter regulations.
